author: Atomic Shrimp
description:
Join me for a while, strolling through the baking hot tracks in the campo near Puerto de Mazarrón in Murcia, Spain.  I had intended to show you the huge population of grasshoppers, but it was even too warm for most of them to be out and about.
 
Slow TV isn't for everyone - nothing is scripted here - no narration or music - nothing much happens, and certainly not on purpose, but that's OK - there are no sudden loud noises in this video and no midroll ads. Mostly you will just hear the crunch of my feet on the gravel, the calls of birds and insects, as well as the occasional distant sounds of human activity.

Join the Atomic Shrimp official Discord server for early access to videos! - https://discord.gg/atomicshrimp

title: Slow TV - A Hot Afternoon Walk in the Spanish Campo
